label: Bible Study
prompt: The people that walked in _____ have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.
verse: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.
note: Matthew quotes this when Jesus begins preaching in Galilee — a great light for people in the dark.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being _____ and grounded in love,
verse: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,
note: Paul prays for roots: faith gives Christ a home in your heart, and love gives you somewhere to grow.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel, and cast him into the _____ of lions. Now the king spake and said unto Daniel, Thy God whom thou servest continually, he will deliver thee.
verse: Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel, and cast him into the den of lions. Now the king spake and said unto Daniel, Thy God whom thou servest continually, he will deliver thee.
note: King Darius threw Daniel to the lions against his own wishes — and still told him his God would deliver him.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Behold, he cometh with _____; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.
verse: Behold, he cometh with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.
note: Echoing Daniel 7:13 and Zechariah 12:10 — the one they pierced returns in full public view.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no _____ of persons:
verse: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:
note: Peter in Cornelius's house, learning his rooftop vision's lesson: God is no 'respecter' of persons — no favorites.
